items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: a guy -- my instructor was from Richmond, Pappa Joe. I don't remember his last name, but anyway, he'd get little jobs for some of us around Richmond.

ctx.x: And at that time there was a theater in Richmond in the colored section right around Second and Lee, and this was '26 to '29 around at that time -- called the Hippodrome Theater. And Bessie Smith used to come there a lot. So, I got a chance to really hear Bessie in this theater a couple of times. And I'd go back to school, you know, in September.

I'd work little odd jobs not actually playing music. But in school I took up bricklaying. And so, a guy -- my instructor was from Richmond, Pappa Joe. I don't remember his last name, but anyway, he'd get little jobs for some of us around Richmond. And this was how we picked up a few dollars.

But I'd play a little bit on the side, you know, and I'd go back to school. So, I left this school in '29 and I went to Washington because some guys from the school -- that's when I really started playing in a lot of bands around Washington.
